description: Brief description of what this PoC does and why

userStories.title: Project initialization
userStories.description: Set up the project structure with the chosen tech stack, install dependencies, create the basic folder layout, and ensure the project builds and runs
acceptanceCriteria: Project has package.json (or equivalent) with all needed dependencies
Basic folder structure exists (src/, tests/ or equivalent)
A simple health check or hello world endpoint/output works
userStories.notes: Choose the simplest tech stack that fits the PoC goals

userStories.title: Core data model
userStories.description: Define and implement the core data structures/models needed for the PoC
acceptanceCriteria: Data models are defined with proper types
At least one test validates the data model

userStories.title: Main feature implementation
userStories.description: Implement the primary feature that demonstrates the PoC's value
acceptanceCriteria: Feature works as described in the PRD description
At least one test covers the main flow

userStories.title: Basic error handling and edge cases
userStories.description: Add error handling for common failure scenarios and validate inputs
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid inputs return clear error messages
Application doesn't crash on unexpected input

userStories.title: Documentation and README
userStories.description: Create a README with setup instructions, usage examples, and architecture overview
acceptanceCriteria: At least one usage example is provided
All tests pass as final verification
